projects.name: JF Resolve
projects.description: Jellyfin bridge that builds virtual STRM libraries and resolves generic Stremio-addon streams through Real-Debrid or AllDebrid at playback time.

aiostreams.note: The project accepts generic Stremio addon manifests, but no first-party evidence was verified that specifically establishes AIOStreams compatibility.

apple_tv.note: Playback is delegated to Jellyfin clients; Apple TV coverage was not separately verified for this record.

android_tv.note: Playback is delegated to Jellyfin clients; Android TV coverage was not separately verified for this record.

web.note: The service provides web endpoints and a virtual Jellyfin library, but browser playback was not separately verified for this record.

evidence.claim: The README describes a Jellyfin bridge that creates virtual STRM libraries, consumes configurable Stremio addon manifests, and resolves playback through Real-Debrid or AllDebrid.
